candidates.author: David Morgan
candidates.text:
Thanks Sean,
Every now and then, I have seen a valid use for #silver that, in theory, utilizes more than the available silver supply.  This is another case. However, these uses have not come to fruition so far.

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
High prices to cure high prices... but it takes time.

New production needs to first replace lost production before it can start pooling up a glut.

I've seen no evidence we're there yet.

candidates.text: Ironically his father knew this well and wrote a treatise on gold, sound money and freedom.  He ignored all that and played the fiat system like a fiddle and became wealthy doing so. His comment that people debasing money is just the system and not particularly evil tells you all

candidates.text: But he's a trader!  gold down for a few months: avoid. lots of morons on X.
